intro: What shows when there's nothing yet, when it's slow, or when it fails: an empty list, loading, an error, a notice, a dialog and a page that isn't there. In his voice, always with a next step.

empty.title: Empty state
empty.note: An empty state is an empty record in a dashed line, not an illustration. It says why it's empty and what comes next, in his voice. An empty section on the home page isn't shown.
empty.englishTitle: I haven't published articles in English yet
empty.englishText: I write in Arabic first. The Arabic articles are here.
empty.filterText: Development with a company: I haven't worked on a project like that yet.
empty.consultText: When you start a consultation, you'll find the conversation, files and meetings here.

error.title: Error state
error.phoneError: The number is short. Write it with the country code, like +967 77 000 0000
error.sectionText: The connection may be weak. The rest of the page works.
error.pageTitle: Something went wrong on our side
error.pageText: It isn't your fault. Try again in a moment, or write to me if it keeps happening.

notice.title: Notice
notice.successText: The change shows in your next messages.
notice.infoText: Change the time zone from your profile.
notice.warningTitle: Access to this document ends in 3 days
notice.warningText: You can request it again after that.
notice.dangerText: What you wrote is kept. Check the connection and send it again.
notice.lineError: The change wasn't saved. Try again.
notice.note: Each tone has its own glyph shape and a title in words, so color never carries the meaning alone. The status line under forms works the same way, smaller.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.openForm: Open the dialog with a form
dialog.closeText: The conversation and files stay in your record and the client's. It can be reopened later.
dialog.formText: Send the time that suits you, and I'll confirm it in the conversation.
dialog.deleteQuestion: 42 messages and 7 files will be deleted, and can't be recovered. The deletion is logged under your name.
dialog.note: Only a dialog interrupts the page. The page behind it is inert, focus stays inside, Escape closes it, and focus goes back to what opened it. A delete needs two confirmations: a question, then typing the word.

lists.title: List states
lists.projectsEmptyText: Development with a company: I haven't worked on a project like that yet.
lists.projectsFailedText: The connection may be weak. The rest of the page works.
lists.articlesEmpty: I haven't written about “supply chains” yet
lists.articlesEmptyText: Try a shorter word, or browse all the articles.
lists.resourcesEmpty: No templates in this area yet
lists.resourcesEmptyText: I add what I use once it's ready to share. Subscribe to hear when.
lists.resourcesFailedText: Check the email address and try again. What you wrote is kept.
lists.coursesEmptyText: I announce upcoming courses in the newsletter first. If your team needs training, ask for a custom one.
lists.coursesFailedText: No seat was booked for you. Try again.
lists.documentsEmpty: No documents are open to you yet
lists.documentsEmptyText: When I open a document you requested, you'll find it here.
lists.documentsFailedText: The documents you chose are still selected.
lists.note: Every list on the site has three states besides its content: empty, loading and error. The text is in his voice, always with a next step.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.note: One sentence in the record's language, a search of the writing, and four ways back. The real page returns status 404.
notFound.openLive: Open a page that doesn't exist
